claim.claim-text: 1. A system for dosing a food product with an active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), the system comprising:

a dosing station including: a reservoir containing an API-containing liquid that includes a cannabinoid at a concentration that is in a range from approximately 50 micrograms per microliter of solution to approximately 1 milligram per microliter of solution, and at least one dosing head in fluid communication with the reservoir so as to deliver the API-containing liquid to the at least one dosing head, wherein the dosing head is spaced from the food product along a direction of travel; and

a support surface configured to support the food product, wherein the system is configured to align the at least one dosing head with the food product, and wherein the dosing station is configured to deliver a plurality of microdroplets of the API-containing liquid from the at least one dosing head to the food product along the direction of travel when the food product is in alignment with the at least one dosing head.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one dosing head is configured to deliver the microdroplets to the food product under gravitational forces.
3. The system of claim 1 or 2, wherein the at least one dosing head is configured to deliver the plurality of microdroplets to an outer surface of the food product.
4. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one dosing head comprises an array of dosing heads that is configured to deliver a plurality of microdroplets onto the food product.

5. The system of claim 4, wherein a first dosing head of the dosing heads of the array delivers a first API-containing liquid, and a second dosing head of the dosing heads of the array delivers a second API-containing liquid different than the first API-containing liquid.
6. The system of claim 1, wherein the API-containing liquid comprises a solution of the API and a solvent.
7. The system of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein each of the microdroplets contains a microquantity of the cannabinoid in a range from approximately 0.1 micrograms to approximately 10 milligrams.
8. The system of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein each of the microdroplets has a volume that is in a range from approximately 2 nanoliters to approximately 10 microliters.
9. The system of claim 8, wherein the volume is in a range from 25 nanoliters to approximately 2 microliters.
10. The system of claim 8, wherein the volume is in a range from approximately 50 nanoliters to approximately 1 microliter.
11. The system of claim 9, wherein the volume is within a range from approximately 1% to approximately 5%, from a predetermined target volume of each of the microdroplets at three sigma.
12. The system of claim 1, wherein the food product is cooked prior to being brought into alignment with the at least one dosing head.
13. The system of claim 1, wherein the food product is a dried fruit or nut.
14. The system of claim 1, wherein the food product is a gummy candy.
15. The system of any one of claims 1 to 14, wherein the at least one dosing head is movable so as to be placed in alignment with the food product.
16. The system of any one of claims 1 to 15, wherein the support surface is movable so as to place the food product in alignment with the at least one dosing head.

17. The system of any one of claims 1 to 16, wherein the food product comprises a plurality of food products, the support surface is configured to support the plurality of food products in alignment with the at least one dosing head, and the at least one dosing head is configured to deliver a respective plurality of microdroplets of the API-containing liquid to each of the plurality of food products.

18. The system of claim 1, comprising a plurality of dosing stations that are configured to deliver different respective APIs to respective food products brought into alignment with the dosing stations, respectively, wherein the different respective APIs have at least one API characteristic different from each other.

19. The system of claim 1, wherein the food product comprises a plurality of food products, the support surface is configured to support the plurality of food products in alignment with the at least one dosing head, and the at least one dosing head delivers respective different APIs to different ones of the aligned food products, wherein the respective different APIs have at least one API characteristic different from each other.

20. The system of claim 1, wherein the food product comprises a plurality of food products, the support surface is configured to support the plurality of food products in alignment with the at least one dosing head, and the at least one dosing head is configured to deliver a respective plurality of microdroplets of the API-containing liquid to each of the plurality of food products.

21. The system of claim 18 or 19, wherein the at least one API characteristic comprises at least one of 1) a concentration of the API, 2) a volume of the API delivered to the food products during the delivering step, 3) a composition of the API, and 4) a modifier mixed with the API, the modifier configured to modify at least one of a flavor, a mechanical property, and an aesthetic of the delivered API, and 5) a location of at least one dosing zone of the food products.
22. The system of claim 1, wherein the API-containing liquid comprises a pure API.
23. The system of claim 1, wherein the at least one dosing head is configured to deliver different APIs to different subzones, respectively, in a delivery zone of the food product.
24. The system of claim 23, wherein the different APIs comprise different concentrations of the cannabinoid.

25. The system of claim 1, further comprising a hopper configured to receive the food product and deliver the food product to a first location of a delivery member that moves the food product to a second location, wherein the at least one dosing head delivers the API to the food product at the second location, and the deliver member subsequently moves the food product from the second location to a third location whereby the food product is transported to a packaging station.
26. The system of claim 25, comprising the delivery member, the dosing station, and the packaging station supported by a common support structure.
27. The system of claim 1, further comprising a heater configured to increase a temperature of the cannabinoid so as to lower a viscosity of the API.

28. The system of claim 1, configured to post-process the food product, including at least one of 1) drying a solvent, 2) increasing a viscosity of the API, 3) further adhering the API to the food product, 4) dispersing the API along the food product, and 5) increasing absorption of the API into the food product.
29. The system of claim 1, configured to deliver the at least one microdroplet of the API-containing liquid at different respective locations in a dosing zone of the food product.
30. The system of claim 1, wherein the cannabinoid is an extract from a marijuana plant, or hemp plant alone or in combination with one or more of a flavonoid or terpene.
